subject: includeHTML fails when big images are included in the html.

messages.author: 993c2b0539a36687
messages.subject: includeHTML fails when big images are included in the html.
parts:
Hi All,

The HTML file it´s OK, it look great in any browser, however, shiny server don´t show the page and logs:
"Warning in readLines(conn): incomplete final line found on ''"

The HTML file is generated through Rmarkdown with option 'self_contained: yes' .
The problem is related to self contained images. If I remove some of then, all work as expected.
According to shiny' logs message, I think the <img> line is too long for shiny.
Any ideas?

Thank in advance!

In order to test it, I've attached a HTML file generated with rmarkdown::render, and shiny server code.

server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
   
})

ui.R
library(markdown)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
   
    titlePanel("includeHTML"),
   
    fluidRow(
        column(12,
               includeHTML("test.html")
        )
    )
))
